{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "To implement test prioritization in a matrix-based workflow, we reorder the matrix dimensions to prioritize configurations likely to fail faster or run more quickly (e.g., older Java versions and standard javac). This aims to reduce the 'time to first failure' feedback loop. We also add a narrow cache for Maven dependencies to ensure the baseline performance is comparable and to follow the instruction to add caching.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - topic/**

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # Reordered to prioritize Java 8 and javac for potentially faster feedback
        java: [ '8', '11', '17', '21', '25'  ]
        compiler: [ 'javac', 'ecj' ]
        extra: [ 'none', 'errorprone' ]
        exclude:
          - java: 25
            compiler: ecj
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - name: Set up JDK
      uses: actions/setup-java@v5
      with:
        distribution: temurin
        java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
        cache: maven
    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
    - name: print Java version
      run: java -version
    - name: Run tests
      run: ./mvnw --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress clean test -P${{ matrix.compiler }} -Dextra=${{ matrix.extra }}
"
}
